summary: Fixed the four production defects that BFF-TEST-FULL-MIGRATION-CORRECTIVE-001's monkeypatch removal surfaced honestly in test_bff_promotion_review_governance.py, without weakening or editing any of the four failing assertions. (1) management_read_models/service.py::ManagementService.get_human_inbox's persona-readiness contributor now attaches blocking_reasons/research_context to each readiness_blocker item, reusing governance/human_inbox.py's existing _human_inbox_persona_blocking_reasons helper instead of hardcoding a literal recommendation id anywhere. (2) The same method's approval_queue surface now reads the store's real dataset_source('approval_queue_items') and degrades to source=local_snapshot/status=degraded, instead of hardcoding source=read_store. (3) command_adapters/service.py::CommandAdapterService.sem_command_response now mirrors any payload['live_capital_mutation'] into audit['live_capital_side_effects'] at command-admission time, for every command type that already declares that params field (a reporting-only audit field; no capital-mutation behavior changed). (4) command_queue.py's CommandStore restores real lazy per-instance caching: __init__ sets self._cache = None; _get_all_commands() re-reads from disk and refreshes self._cache on every call while the file exists (preserving multi-instance coherence, see tests/test_command_store_multiprocess.py), and falls back to the in-memory snapshot only when the file is transiently missing; _save_command appends the new record to the cache when populated. The stale CommandStore._cache = [] class-level default patch in main.py (a defensive workaround from a prior generation that never implemented real caching) is removed as dead code now that the instance always has its own _cache.

acceptance_criteria_status.ac4_defect_three_audit_live_capital_side: Fixed in services/control-plane/bff/command_adapters/service.py::CommandAdapterService.sem_command_response (~L808-817), the single shared command-admission path used by every HumanGateApprove/HumanGateReject promotion-review decision (via personas/service.py::_sem_command_response -> personas/routes/ranking.py::bff_management_promotion_review_decision). Added exactly one reporting-only line: `if "live_capital_mutation" in payload: audit_ctx["live_capital_side_effects"] = bool(payload.get("live_capital_mutation"))`. This is additive and narrowly scoped: it only populates the new audit field for command types whose payload already declares live_capital_mutation (the promotion-review decision payload already sets it to False at personas/service.py::_promotion_review_decision_payload, unchanged by this task); no real capital write, mutation, or side effect was introduced, and no existing capital-authority behavior changed.
acceptance_criteria_status.ac5_defect_four_command_store_lazy_cache: Investigated: CommandStore never defined self._cache in __init__ or used it in any read/write path in command_queue.py; the only place `_cache` existed at all was a defensive `if not hasattr(CommandStore, "_cache"): CommandStore._cache = []` class-level patch added to main.py in a prior generation (confirmed via `git log -p --follow -- services/control-plane/bff/main.py`), evidently added so `instance._cache` would not raise AttributeError for some caller, without ever restoring the real caching behavior test_command_store_caching expects. Verdict: production was wrong, not the test -- test_command_store_caching is not stale. Fix: command_queue.py::CommandStore.__init__ now sets `self._cache: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None`; _get_all_commands() re-reads from disk and reassigns self._cache to the fresh list on every call while the file exists (so a second CommandStore instance pointed at the same file always sees the freshest data -- required by tests/test_command_store_multiprocess.py::test_command_store_multi_instance_cache_coherence, re-verified below), and returns the in-memory self._cache unchanged only when the file is transiently missing/unreadable; _save_command appends the newly persisted record to self._cache when it is already populated. update_status/_update_commands already operated on the exact list object returned by _get_all_commands(), so their in-place mutations now transparently keep self._cache in sync with no further change needed there. The stale main.py class-level patch (services/control-plane/bff/main.py:120-121) is removed as dead code.
